'''Darth Andru's tomb''' was a tomb constructed for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Andru]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Located west of [[Kaas City]], the tomb was at the edge of the [[Kaas City expansion district]], and was visited several times by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]].<ref name="TOR" />

By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic]], [[Darth Thanaton]] was known to lead Sith he despised here in order for them to be killed by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Andru's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]].<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Sith Hierarchy|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>
